tasks.subject: Execute PromQL coverage expansion plan
tasks.description: Container task for executing the full scope described in .pi/promql-coverage-plan/README.md. This task is complete when Tier 1, Tier 2, the shared windowed-arrays source, predict_linear, resets, and double_exponential_smoothing/holt_winters have all shipped with the required local/native implementations, differential coverage, and validation.

tasks.subject: Deliver Tier 1 trivial coverage sweep
tasks.description: Container task for the Tier 1 slice from .pi/promql-coverage-plan/01-tier-1-trivial.md. This groups the analyzer/logical/local/native/test work needed to land the trivial scalar math, clamp, trig, date/time, sort, missing aggregators, and basic over-time stats in one sweep.

tasks.subject: Implement Tier 1 trivial coverage additions
tasks.description: Add Tier 1 support from .pi/promql-coverage-plan/01-tier-1-trivial.md across analyzer, logical builder, local execution, native renderer/optimizer, and harness/tests. Scope includes scalar math, clamp, trig, time/date functions, root sort variants, aggregators stddev/stdvar/quantile/group, and over-time stats stddev_over_time/stdvar_over_time/present_over_time. Done means analyzer accepts the full Tier 1 set, local and native execution are wired per plan, and tests/corpus/snapshots cover the new surface.

tasks.subject: Deliver Tier 2 moderate coverage
tasks.description: Container task for the Tier 2 slice from .pi/promql-coverage-plan/02-tier-2-moderate.md. This task is complete when scalar(v), mad_over_time, and info all ship same-slice local+native with their required semantic edge-case coverage.

tasks.subject: Implement scalar(v) same-slice local and native support
tasks.description: Add analyzer, execution, native rendering, and differential/unit coverage for scalar(v) per .pi/promql-coverage-plan/02-tier-2-moderate.md. Done means scalar(v) returns ScalarValue semantics matching Prometheus for single-series, empty, and multi-series inputs, with native CASE/count lowering diff-tested against the local implementation.

tasks.subject: Implement mad_over_time same-slice local and native support
tasks.description: Add analyzer, local execution, native lowering, and differential/unit coverage for mad_over_time per .pi/promql-coverage-plan/02-tier-2-moderate.md. This must consume the shared windowed-arrays source from the predict_linear slice rather than duplicating its own source logic.

tasks.subject: Implement info same-slice local and native support
tasks.description: Add analyzer, local execution, info-series lookup/join behavior, native lowering, and differential/unit coverage for info per .pi/promql-coverage-plan/02-tier-2-moderate.md. Done means enrichment, conflict handling, duplicate-info failure, and no-info pass-through semantics are covered and the info-series convention is documented in code.

tasks.subject: Build shared windowed-arrays source for coverage functions
tasks.description: Implement the reusable native windowed-arrays source described in .pi/promql-coverage-plan/03-predict-linear.md and referenced by mad_over_time and double_exponential_smoothing. Done means the renderer has one shared path that yields per-(series, grid_ts) window timestamp/value arrays, with snapshot/integration coverage for the selected implementation strategy.

tasks.subject: Deliver advanced range-function coverage
tasks.description: Container task for the remaining range-function slices after Tier 2: predict_linear, resets, and double_exponential_smoothing/holt_winters. This task is complete when each ships with the required same-slice local/native support and documented fallback behavior where applicable.

tasks.subject: Implement predict_linear same-slice local and native support
tasks.description: Add analyzer, local execution, shared-source-based native lowering, and differential/unit coverage for predict_linear per .pi/promql-coverage-plan/03-predict-linear.md. Done means the local implementation matches upstream linearRegression behavior, the native path uses the shared windowed-arrays source, and the documented edge-case corpus passes.

tasks.subject: Implement resets same-slice local and native support
tasks.description: Add analyzer, local execution, native lowering, and dedicated boundary-focused differential/unit coverage for resets per .pi/promql-coverage-plan/04-resets.md. Done means reset counting matches Prometheus across monotonic, reset, boundary, NaN, and empty-window cases both locally and natively.

tasks.subject: Implement double_exponential_smoothing and holt_winters support
tasks.description: Add analyzer support for both names, local execution, shared-source-based native lowering, and differential/unit coverage for double_exponential_smoothing/holt_winters per .pi/promql-coverage-plan/05-holt-winters.md. Done means aliasing, factor validation, upstream-parity smoothing behavior, and either working arrayFold-based native lowering or an explicit activated-local-only fallback with tracking note are all in place.

tasks.subject: Add Tier 1 aggregators and over-time stats
tasks.description: Implement the Tier 1 additions that reuse existing aggregation/range-function infrastructure: aggregators stddev/stdvar/quantile/group and range functions stddev_over_time/stdvar_over_time/present_over_time. Scope includes analyzer, logical planning, local execution, native analysis/renderer/storage aggregation support, and focused unit/native tests.
tasks.activeForm: Adding Tier 1 aggregators and over-time stats

tasks.subject: Add Tier 1 scalar, clamp, trig, and date-time transforms
tasks.description: Implement the Tier 1 scalar transform coverage from .pi/promql-coverage-plan/01-tier-1-trivial.md: scalar math, clamp family, trig functions, pi/time/timestamp, and minute/hour/day/month/year functions with correct metric-name and day_of_week semantics across analyzer, planning, local execution, and native lowering.

tasks.subject: Add Tier 1 sort variants
tasks.description: Implement Tier 1 support for sort, sort_desc, sort_by_label, and sort_by_label_desc with analyzer validation, planning/execution support, and any native/root-order handling that is safe per the plan.

tasks.subject: Add Tier 1 harness, unit, and renderer coverage
tasks.description: Expand Tier 1 validation coverage in harness/corpus/queries.json, exec tests, planner/logical tests, and native snapshot/optimizer tests so the full Tier 1 surface has differential and focused regression coverage per .pi/promql-coverage-plan/01-tier-1-trivial.md.
